description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the BasicWorkSchedule service in the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to retrieving work shift start/end times and length for an employee, utilizing mock objects to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: BasicWorkScheduleTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the BasicWorkSchedule service methods related to employee work shifts, including start/end times and shift length.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Tests retrieving the work shift start and end times for an employee with an assigned work shift.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTimeEmployeeWorkShiftEmpty
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the employee has no assigned work shift, expecting default start and end times.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Tests retrieving the length of the employee's work shift.
